name: How long does wainscoting installation usually take in a home?

mainEntity.name: How long does wainscoting installation usually take in a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timeline depends on room size, wall condition, and how detailed the design is. A single room may move quickly if the walls are ready, while rooms with repair work, custom trim, or stair sections take longer because layout and finishing are more precise.
acceptedAnswer.description: A simple room can be fairly quick, but custom layouts and wall repairs add time. The biggest factors are room size, detail level, and how much prep the walls need.
